inputs.text: South Dakota is right to insist that voters document their citizenship. That is a basic duty of a state, not voter suppression. When political activists attack even ordinary safeguards, they put partisan interests ahead of public confidence. A nation’s elections depend on clear rules, personal responsibility, and respect for the institutions that uphold them.
